svg.title: CI/CD Deployment Pipeline
svg.desc: This flowchart shows a typical CI/CD deployment pipeline. It starts with a developer push, goes through a CI pipeline that either passes or fails tests. If tests pass, the system builds a Docker image, pushes it to a registry, deploys to Kubernetes, and updates the service. If tests fail, it notifies the developer.
